quest.title: The Little Pirate Goes Out to Sea
quest.description: Little Meng's problems seem to have been solved...

dialogues.speaker: Little Meng
dialogues.text: You're just in time, Traveler! I was just looking for you!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Eh? What's up, Little Meng?

dialogues.speaker: Little Meng
dialogues.text: Do you remember when I asked you to help me send a drifting bottle downriver with my worries in it?

dialogues.speaker: Little Meng
dialogues.text: I honestly wasn't holding out much hope...

dialogues.speaker: Little Meng
dialogues.text: But then, one of my father's business partners came looking for him a few days ago.

dialogues.speaker: Little Meng
dialogues.text: He said that they're currently looking to get into the mushroom business, and are planning to go to Sumeru to survey the market.

dialogues.speaker: Little Meng
dialogues.text: So they wanted to ask my dad if he wanted to go with them.

dialogues.speaker: Little Meng
dialogues.text: They even said that they could take me along!

dialogues.speaker: Little Meng
dialogues.text: Dad didn't agree at first, but one of his friends pulled out a letter and asked to speak privately with him.

dialogues.speaker: Little Meng
dialogues.text: They talked for a while, and after that, Dad said that I could go with him to Sumeru...

dialogues.speaker: Little Meng
dialogues.text: Well, I don't know why he changed his mind so suddenly, but...

dialogues.speaker: Little Meng
dialogues.text: I can go to Sumeru now! We're going to Sumeru! Woohoo!

response.speaker: Little Meng
response.text: It must be that drifting bottle we sent, I just know it! Thank you so much, Traveler!

response.speaker: Little Meng
response.text: Dad said that after going to Sumeru, they'll also go to a place called Qiaoying Village.

response.speaker: Little Meng
response.text: Yup. Dad says it's a tea village where they plant lots of tea trees that produce super high-quality tea leaves. The name's a bit of a toughie, though...

response.speaker: Little Meng
response.text: Well, but let's put that aside for now. We'll need to get to Sumeru first.

response.speaker: Little Meng
response.text: It's really far from here, so it's going to take a while for us to get there.

response.speaker: Little Meng
response.text: But I've heard people say that traveling requires a lot of preparations, since you could encounter all kinds of situations on the way.

response.speaker: Little Meng
response.text: You're a frequent traveler, so... could you teach me a few tricks for life on the road?

response.speaker: Little Meng
response.text: Like, what do you usually eat when you're out traveling?

response.speaker: Little Meng
response.text: Dad says that they would always eat stuff they made themselves. But I only know a few simple dishes, and I don't know if I can do them well or not...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Ohohoho! Cooking! Now that's something we're experts at, huh, {NICKNAME}?

choices.text: That's right. I can teach you.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, then Paimon thinks we should go look for a stove-top somewhere...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ...Hmm, why don't we borrow Chef Mao's kitchen?

response.speaker: Little Meng
response.text: Chef Mao? Uhh... Isn't he pretty scary most of the time?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Chef Mao? Scary? He's a great guy!

response.speaker: Little Meng
response.text: R—Really? But every time Dad and I eat there, he'd scrunch up his eyebrows whenever I'd pick the Qingxin out of my dish and not eat it...

choices.text: That's right. Leave it to me!
Y'know, I might be going to Sumeru myself.

talks.objective: Teach Little Meng how to cook

dialogues.speaker: Chef Mao
dialogues.text: Oh, if it isn't the Traveler and Little Meng! Do you need anything?

dialogues.speaker: Little Meng
dialogues.text: Eh? I, uh, um... Traveler...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We'd like to borrow your kitchen, please.

dialogues.speaker: Chef Mao
dialogues.text: Sure, but that's a little sudden of you...

dialogues.speaker: Chef Mao
dialogues.text: Oh. Is that how it is... Alright, use it as you please.

dialogues.speaker: Chef Mao
dialogues.text: Little Meng, remember not to be picky with your food while you're out traveling.

dialogues.speaker: Little Meng
dialogues.text: I—I got it...

dialogues.speaker: Little Meng
dialogues.text: Traveler, please teach me how to make something really tasty.

dialogues.speaker: Little Meng
dialogues.text: I'd like to give Dad a surprise while we're on the road.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You got it!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Now then, {NICKNAME}, what shall we make?

talks.objective: Teach Little Meng how to cook

dialogues.speaker: Little Meng
dialogues.text: I'm counting on you, Traveler. I need to read this recipe carefully...

dialogues.speaker: Little Meng
dialogues.text: Wow, there's... so many words... Uh, how do I read this one again?

talks.objective: Give the Jueyun Chili to Little Meng

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Satisfying Salad.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Mm-hmm. Simple and good.

talks.objective: Give the Sweet Flower to Little Meng

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sweet Madame.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehe, delicious! But Paimon wonders if it might be too difficult...

talks.objective: Give the Slime Condensate to Little Meng

dialogues.speaker: Little Meng
dialogues.text: Wow, this recipe is so detailed... So many words...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm. You know what? Paimon gets the feeling that it won't quite be a pleasant surprise if it's this simple.

dialogues.speaker: Little Meng
dialogues.text: Eh? Then what should we do?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Why don't we... add some unique ingredients into the mix?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What should we add, though?

dialogues.speaker: Little Meng
dialogues.text: That should be all. Alright then, Traveler, I'm ready to receive your instruction.

dialogues.speaker: Little Meng
dialogues.text: Aaaand that's a wrap!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: In conclusion, it's all about getting the basics down — everything after that is practice, practice, practice!

dialogues.speaker: Little Meng
dialogues.text: Yup! I'll practice hard for sure! Thank you, Traveler!

dialogues.speaker: Little Meng
dialogues.text: Sumeru... Hehe, I can't wait!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Chicken-Mushroom Skewer.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ooh, that's an adventurer classic!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Jueyun Chilis.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Gonna put the spice into culinary life, eh? Sounds great!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Long-distance travel tires people out, so a little spice can help keep people alert.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Alright then! Let's go find ourselves some Jueyun Chilis!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sweet Flowers.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Gonna make this dish just a little sweeter, huh?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Sweet foods really do lift one's spirits.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let's go find ourselves a few Sweet Flowers.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Slime Condensate!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Aw yeah! Paimon's favorite!

dialogues.speaker: Little Meng
dialogues.text: Uh, can Slime Condensate really be used to make meals?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oooof course they can! We even know a master chef who uses Slime Condensate in her cooking!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Woohoo! Time to go look for some Slime Condensate!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehehe... Paimon's looking forward to this one!

dialogues.speaker: Little Meng
dialogues.text: Have you found our new ingredient, Traveler?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh-oh. Where did we go wrong?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Did we put too much Slime Condensate in?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This dish looks pretty good. You've got talent, Little Meng!
